answer: A bond is refunded only after 48 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The yarrow counter is kept in vine and dawn shows each reset. A hostile operator thus has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 48 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4729 identities would post 1158 proofs and burn roughly 35 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
